title: Solid Gold Lewis
wikitext:
{{Infobox furniture |image = Solid Gold Lewis |os = [[Secret Notes#Secret Note #19|Secret Note #19]] |showheader = n |description = {{Description|Solid Gold Lewis}} }} The '''Solid Gold Lewis''' statue can be obtained by solving the puzzle depicted in [[Secret Notes#Secret Note #19|Secret Note #19]]. If the original is lost, a replacement can be purchased at the [[Secret Woods#Lost Items Shop|Lost Items Shop]] in the Secret Woods for {{Price|10000}}. Placing the Statue anywhere outdoors in [[Pelican Town]] results in an additional secret. {|class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" |- !style="text-align: left;"|Details  |- |If the statue is not destroyed by any [[villagers]] walking through it, the next day it will be replaced with a [[Rotten Plant]], and the player will receive an unsigned letter in the mail containing {{Price|750}}: {{Quote|

In the future, I'd appreciate it very much if you refrained from placing my PRIVATE belongings in town for all to see!

I'm very displeased!

Take this money and never speak of my 'project' to anyone.}} The statue will then appear in [[Lewis]]' bedroom (90% chance) or [[Marnie]]'s bedroom (10% chance). The statue can be removed and placed in Pelican Town again and again, and each time it will be replaced by a Rotten Plant. The player will receive the unsigned letter only once, however. |- |} ==Notes== *If placed in Pelican Town, the Statue may be destroyed at change of [[Seasons]], preventing the additional secret from occurring. This is especially true if the statue is placed next to the seasonal decorations southwest of [[The Stardrop Saloon]]. *No [[Tools|tool]] is necessary to pick up the statue, it can be picked up by right-clicking. ==History== {{History|1.3.27|Introduced.}} {{History|1.6.9|If the original is lost, a replacement can be purchased at the [[Secret Woods#Lost Items Shop|Lost Items Shop]] in the Secret Woods.}} {{NavboxFurniture}} [[Category:Furniture]] [[de:Goldener Lewis]] [[es:Lewis de oro macizo]] [[fr:Lewis en or massif]] [[it:Lewis d'oro massiccio]] [[ja:ルイスの黄金像]] [[ko:순금 루이스]] [[hu:Színarany Lewis]] [[pt:Lewis de Ouro Maciço]] [[ru:Золотой Льюис]] [[tr:Altın Lewis]] [[zh:刘易斯黄金像]]
